report_comment.text: VGLL2 encodes a transcriptional cofactor involved in skeletal-muscle differentiation. NCOA2 encodes a nuclear-receptor transcriptional coactivator. VGLL2::NCOA2 has been identified by molecular analysis in congenital/infantile spindle cell rhabdomyosarcoma, a group distinct from MYOD1-mutant spindle/sclerosing rhabdomyosarcoma. In the original small infantile fusion-positive cohort, six patients with long-term follow-up were alive and well; two had experienced local recurrences.
